dispute.statement: The app estimated 22 km; the driver turned off the route without a word and the meter read 23 km at the end. Please refund the extra distance.

incidents.message: (3/9)18:27 Vehicle breakdown on East Coast Parkway (towards Changi). Avoid lane 1.

driver_statement: There was a breakdown on the route, the whole road was slow, so I took another way. Check the LTA incident feed.
